lean.name: UpperTheory.V.Af.CongruenceNumberRankThree
lean.note: In the first U(3) formulation, one size-controlled integer bounds the sum of ℓ-adic valuations of the Frobenius trace differences from an Eisenstein trace for every ℓ ≠ 2,p. Lean derives this formulation under separate hypotheses, and the compiled RH argument uses the version with different admissibility conditions.
